crossRefs.note: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which…
After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

people.name: Emmaus
people.line: Emmaus, village where Jesus appeared to two disciples after resurrection

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: That same day two of them were going to a village called Emmaus, about seven miles from Jerusalem.
translations.kjv: And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs.
translations.asv: And behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was threescore furlongs from Jerusalem.
